title: Camera Gear for a Tanzania Safari
excerpt: Which camera, lenses and accessories should you bring for a safari in Tanzania? A practical overview for every budget.
body:
You do not need professional gear to take great safari photos, but the right choices help.

## Camera

- A mirrorless or DSLR camera with interchangeable lenses gives the most flexibility.
- A bridge camera with a strong zoom is a lighter alternative.
- Modern smartphones are good for landscapes and close sightings.

## Lenses

- 100–400 mm or 150–600 mm for wildlife.
- 24–70 mm for landscapes and camp life.

## Accessories

- Beanbag for support on the vehicle.
- Extra batteries and memory cards.
- Lens cloth and blower against dust.
- Power bank and adapters (type G plugs are common in Tanzania).

## Binoculars

Not a camera, but essential. 8x42 or 10x42 works well.

## Luggage

Watch the weight limits on [safari flights](/blog/domestic-flights-luggage/).

## Drones

Not allowed in parks without permits. See [drones in Tanzania](/blog/drones-in-tanzania/).

See [Tanzania for photographers](/blog/tanzania-for-photographers/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
